exposure: Timing of IUD insertion (immediate vs mediate postpartum)
IUD insertion during the immediate puerperium
IUD insertion during the mediate puerperium
cohort: 170 patients who received a TCU-380 copper IUD during the immediate or mediate postpartum period
finding: In this prospective study of 170 women, vaginal delivery was found to be a significant predictor of IUD expulsion (OR 4.23, 95% CI 1.94-9.25) when the IUD was inserted in the postpartum period.
mod_finding: The risk of IUD expulsion after vaginal delivery was greater than CS.
